400 error when the prompt exceeds the model's maximum context length

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest
from liter_llm import ContextWindowExceededError, Error

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Very long prompt that exceeds the context window...\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
        await client.chat(request)
    except ContextWindowExceededError as error:
        print(f"ContextWindowExceededError: {error}")
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
